links.outcome: AUC in internal validation versus external testing
links.effect: AUC 0.94 in internal validation dropped to 0.88 in external testing.
links.quote: LIDGAX achieved area under the curve (AUC) values of 0.94 (internal validation) and 0.88 (external testing), outperforming the other five ML models.

links.outcome: AI diagnostic performance and time versus six radiologists on the same cases
links.effect: LIDGAX improved sensitivity by 1.2-8.5%, specificity by 0.0-4.6%, and balanced accuracy by 1.8-6.6% versus radiologists. It reduced diagnostic time by 30.44-35.76 s per patient.
links.quote: Compared to six radiologists, LIDGAX improved sensitivity (1.2-8.5%), specificity (0.0-4.6%), and balanced accuracy (1.8-6.6%), while reducing average diagnostic time per patient by 30.44-35.76 s.

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an ML model (LIDGAX) using clinical, lab, and imaging features, and compares its performance and diagnostic speed against six radiologists in a reader-style evaluation.
